testcase.name: known metadata translates without rewriting diagnostics or details
exact literal fallback never guesses a translated or parameterized diagnostic
parameters are scalar literal text in source order and substituted once
decoder rejects malformed localization metadata but leaves original fields intact
unknown source and malformed direct parameters use reviewed generic
realtime decoding retains the same metadata as REST errors
embedded data exposes source hash metadata and portable chunks
UI exception boundary preserves intentional messages and legacy diagnostics
first start creates a guest, keeps its credential and says hello with the token
an unsupported sim version says which side is out of date
a returning player signs in with the device credential or refresh token
without consent to sign in, the socket connects anonymously
responses reach their own requests; timeouts and events are delivered
requests made before the socket is online wait for it
lost connections retry with growing, jittered backoff
a connection that never opens times out and retries
tokens refresh before expiry, rotate the stored token and re-authenticate the socket
a refused refresh token falls back to the device credential
a refresh that fails on the network is retried while the token lasts
a refused token at hello continues anonymously and signs in again
update_required stops retrying
an idle socket is checked with session.ping and replaced when silent
browser sign-in opens the page, survives a reconnect and adopts the session
browser sign-in failures, cancellation and expiry
session.revoked signs out and stops automatic sign-in
sign-out revokes the refresh token, reconnects anonymously and stays signed out
stop cancels everything and credentials stay per instance
rename patches the account
REST calls return an id that cancels them; a cancelled call never calls back
the instance description is fetched once per start and shared
a scope cancels its owner's calls and listeners when the owner goes away
a handler that destroys another owner in the same update does not reach it
requests encode as the realtime envelope
responses and events decode; malformed frames are rejected
RFC 3339 timestamps convert to epoch milliseconds
token lifetime comes from the JWT claims
refreshes are scheduled well before expiry
backoff grows exponentially to a cap, with bounded jitter
SHA-256 matches the FIPS 180-4 vectors
the local sim version carries this build's versions
